cards.text: First up, a song of ascents by David, Israel's king (2 Samuel 5:3). He opens with 'Behold,' which is Bible for EVERYBODY LOOK AT THIS. He's found something good and pleasant, and he wants the whole room to see it.

cards.question: What does David say is so good and pleasant?

answers.text: Brothers singing on the road together

cards.text: Then David paints a picture: fine oil, poured on a priest's head and running down onto his beard (Exodus 28:1).

cards.question: In David's picture, the fine oil runs down ___'s beard.

cards.text: That's Aaron, Moses' brother (Exodus 4:14). And take it from the stamper with the biggest mustache in the Dorinverse: once something lands up top, it is GOING places.

cards.question: In David's picture, the oil runs down Aaron's beard and keeps going. Where does it reach next?

answers.text: Over the collar of his robes
All the way down to his feet
Onto the floor of the tent

cards.question: True or false: David uses the oil running down Aaron's beard to show how good it is when brothers live together in harmony.

cards.text: And David's not done, because this man does NOT do one picture when he can do two. Picture number two: the dew of Hermon, falling.

cards.question: David pictures the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of ___.

cards.text: Dew keeps those mountains green and growing. And there, David says nice and easy, the LORD has bestowed a blessing.

cards.question: What blessing does David say the LORD has bestowed there?

answers.text: The blessing of victory in battle
The blessing of a great name

cards.text: Now the second song, another song of ascents, and it's even shorter. It calls out to all the servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD.

cards.question: What does this song call the servants of the LORD who serve by night to do?

answers.text: Come and rest from their work
Come and keep watch at the gate

cards.text: These folks work the NIGHT SHIFT for the LORD. I've baked through a night or two myself, friend, and by sunrise my mustache is the only thing holding my eyes open.

cards.question: As they bless the LORD, what does the song tell these night servants to do with their hands?

answers.text: Lift them up to the sanctuary

cards.text: Then comes the last line, and it calls the LORD the Maker of heaven and earth. Friend, I've got one little cookie planet, and I didn't even make THAT.

cards.question: True or false: In the last line, the song calls once more for people to bless the LORD.
The song ends: "May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from ___."
